recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century style album cover featuring a close-up, colorized portrait of a male singer in a dark suit and green tie, set against a deep burgundy background with right-aligned, multi-tiered typography in yellow and red.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, looking slightly off-camera to the right.
Typography is stacked vertically in the right third, creating a balanced asymmetrical composition.
Warm yellow text contrasts sharply against the dark, moody background for high legibility.
coreInvariants: Deep burgundy or dark maroon background color.
Colorized vintage photographic style with high facial detail.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait positioned on the left, cropped at the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes and smile, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves right to the primary title, then down through the secondary information to the bottom-right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep dark space on the right side provides a canvas for the text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale skin tones and white shirt collar.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the main name and red for the secondary title.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark background and the bright, saturated yellow text.

letterConstructionRules: Tall, narrow proportions for the main name.
Heavy, blocky slab-serif for the secondary title.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Triadic color pairing (Yellow/Red/Green) with contrasting typographic weights (Condensed vs. Heavy Slab).

preserve: Condensed proportions of the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the condensed, bold verticality of the main name.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Rockwell Extra Bold or Stymie Black
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif style of the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a colorized 1950s-style portrait of a smiling man in a dark suit and olive green tie, positioned on the left side of a dark burgundy background. The lighting should be soft and classic, leaving the right side of the frame in deep shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned text in the dark space on the right. Use a tall, condensed yellow sans-serif for the primary name at the top. Below it, use a heavy red slab-serif for the title in all caps. Add smaller yellow metadata text at the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the main name in a condensed yellow font?
Is the secondary title in a bold red slab-serif?
Does the portrait have a vintage colorized aesthetic?

adjustableVariables: Specific font weight of the slab-serif
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles
Record label logo in the bottom left
CD set icon in the bottom right
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Verify the colorization looks like a hand-tinted photograph.
Check that the yellow text is the most prominent element.
Confirm the right-alignment is consistent across all text blocks.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a left-weighted vintage portrait with a right-aligned, three-color typographic stack (Yellow/Red/Yellow) on a dark, monochromatic background.
